name: koora-break-realtime-pipeline
description: Real-time match event pipeline for Koora Break

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix mock-statsperform && npm install --prefix koora-backend
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n MOCK,BACKEND,CLIENT -c blue,green,yellow "npm run start:mock" "npm run start:backend" "sleep 3 && npm run open"
scripts.open: xdg-open client/index.html || open client/index.html || start client/index.html
